name: @firespoon/pi-antigravity-bridge
description: Gemini provider and AskAntigravity tool for Pi on the Antigravity ACP server (restricted custom agent with Pi tools via MCP) or the stream-json agy CLI fallback. Use antigravity/* models in Pi with /model picker support.
